paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.28% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.19%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-0.80%). Brent crude changed -5.33% to 109.64. Gold changed +0.87% to 4,073.6001. Bitcoin changed +0.69% to 80,558.7188. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.997%, a relative move of +0.22%. Among the firms tracked, HSBC (-5.43%) and BHP (+4.07%) moved the most.
